stem.text: A sample of magnesium contains the isotopes ${}^{24}\text{Mg}$, ${}^{25}\text{Mg}$ and ${}^{26}\text{Mg}$ only.
The percentage abundance of ${}^{25}\text{Mg}$ and ${}^{26}\text{Mg}$ is the same.
The relative atomic mass of magnesium in the sample is 24.3.
What is the percentage abundance of ${}^{24}\text{Mg}$?
